columns_to_rows.description: Demote header columns into label/value rows - wide to long, nothing lost
columns_to_rows.not_a_transpose: transpose (slice_data) rotates the grid keeping one dimension in the headers; this ELIMINATES the header dimension by turning header names into data
columns_to_rows.inverse: rows_to_columns restores the wide layout (losslessly, because that processor verifies uniqueness)
columns_to_rows.column_split: give id_columns, value_columns, or both; the missing one is the complement, and with both given every column must be claimed - pandas.melt silently drops unclaimed columns and this processor refuses instead

conditional_format.description: Write native Excel conditional-formatting rules that stay live in the file
conditional_format.vocabulary: canonical ERP condition names (filter_data's equals, greater_than, is_empty, ... plus between, duplicates, unique in the same style); one spelling per condition
conditional_format.formula_convention: same as inject_formulas - write for data row 2 with {col:Header Name} placeholders - except placeholders resolve $-LOCKED here so row-wise tests cannot drift sideways as Excel translates the rule across its range; modern function names get the _xlfn storage prefix automatically
conditional_format.targeting: apply_to: entire_row, columns: [names], or a literal range
conditional_format.ordering: list order is Excel priority order; stop_if_true supported
conditional_format.per_column_anchoring: text, blank, duplicate and unique conditions emit one Excel rule per named column, each anchored to its own range (and duplicates are per-column domains by design)

deduplicate_data.description: Collapse rows to one per key, keeping all columns, reporting value conflicts
conflict_outputs: per-key warning log with disputed columns and values
optional stage of conflicted rows (kept and discarded, annotated)
optional report file, written only when conflicts exist
deduplicate_data.column_handling: all columns kept - nothing to enumerate, nothing to silently lose

a stage a later step needs fails loudly at that step, naming it

free_stages.reporting: logs stage count and approximate MB returned

declare_dynamic_formulas.description: Declare dynamic-era formulas in a finished xlsx to retire the implicit @
declare_dynamic_formulas.when_to_use: repairing a file already on disk (an inherited donor, a flushed output); for recipe outputs prefer the settings key declare_dynamic_formulas: true
declare_dynamic_formulas.safety: only formulas containing post-dynamic-array functions are marked by default, so legacy implicit-intersection semantics cannot be changed; extend with extra_functions only for files whose formulas are known recipe-authored
declare_dynamic_formulas.relation_to_injection: cells written by inject_formulas need neither this processor nor extra_functions: the session registers them by provenance and the at-save pass (settings declare_dynamic_formulas: true) declares them automatically, whatever functions they use

excel_data_validation.description: Native Excel data-validation rules: dropdowns, bounds, formula gates, prompts
excel_data_validation.list_sources: exactly one of values_list (inline), list_from_named_range (pairs with lookup tabs and manage_named_objects), or list_from_spill_ref ("$Z$2#" anchors)
excel_data_validation.bounds_vocabulary: operator + minimum/maximum for between/not_between; operator + compare_to for the six comparisons; bounds accept numbers, "=formulas", ISO dates, and clock times (auto-converted to DATE()/TIME())
excel_data_validation.targeting: apply_to_ranges is ALWAYS a list of A1 cells/ranges; one rule may cover several areas (multi-area sqref)
excel_data_validation.behaviors: allow_blank (default true), show_dropdown (list only, default true), input_prompt {title, message}, error_alert {style: stop/warning/information, title, message}
excel_data_validation.enforcement_scope: fires on MANUAL entry only - paste, fill-down and formulas bypass Excel data validation; use verify_data for pipeline integrity
excel_data_validation.session: file operation on the workbook session, like conditional_format - run after export, before flush

excel_options: sheet selection by name or index

inject_formulas.description: Inject live or dead formulas with name-addressed cells and fill-down
inject_formulas.column_placeholders: {col:Header Name} in cell refs and formulas resolves to the column letter from the header row at injection time, so upstream column insertions cannot silently repoint a formula
inject_formulas.fill_down: fill_down: true fills a formula from its origin cell to the last data row, translating relative references per row the way Excel's own fill handle does
inject_formulas.function_name_translation: modern function names (XLOOKUP, IFS, FILTER, ...) are stored with the _xlfn. prefixes Excel requires internally, and display without them
inject_formulas.dynamic_array_declaration: live-mode cells register with the workbook session as recipe-authored; with settings declare_dynamic_formulas: true they are declared dynamic-array-aware at save and open without the implicit-intersection @ (any function, by provenance)
inject_formulas.array_formula_caveat: array_formula: true stores a legacy CSE array formula ({braces}); use it only for formulas that genuinely are array formulas - it is NOT the fix for the @ display
